about.title: About
about.betaNotice: This platform is under active development and currently in BETA. Features may change, answers should be checked against their cited sources, and some operations are still restricted to administrators.
about.description: Agroecology Map AI is a free software tool created to make agroecological knowledge easier to find, understand, and share. The platform lets people query scientific papers, technical texts, booklets, manuals, theses, and reports through natural language questions, making materials that are often long or scattered more accessible to the people who need them in everyday work.

highlights.sourceBased: Based on scientific and technical sources

about.ragTitle: A RAG AI, Not a Generic AI
about.ragDescription: Unlike a generic chatbot, Agroecology Map AI answers from the documents available in the knowledge base. When someone asks a question, the system looks for the most relevant passages, organizes that information, and builds an answer with references to the sources it used. This helps prevent fabricated answers and lets each person check where the information came from.
about.para1: The goal is to support farmers, researchers, extension workers, students, educators, communities, and social movements working with agroecology, food production, soil care, biodiversity, and traditional knowledge. The tool does not replace critical reading or field experience, but it helps open paths: finding concepts, comparing materials, locating references, and turning complex documents into more accessible conversations.
about.para2: The platform is still in beta. Chat is available to registered users, while uploading and organizing new documents remains restricted to administrators. This care allows access to expand gradually while preserving quality, safety, and traceability in the answers.
about.para3: Our long-term goal is to build local, self-hostable AI infrastructure for agroecology. The platform already supports pluggable backends, such as cloud DeepSeek or local models through Ollama. As open models mature, we want to reduce external dependencies and strengthen technological sovereignty for communities.
about.agroecologyMapDescription: The project grows within the Agroecology Map ecosystem, a citizen science, open data, and free software initiative that has mapped agroecological experiences and connected people across regions for 8 years. While Agroecology Map records practices and territories, Agroecology Map AI turns texts and documents into an interactive knowledge base, carrying the same values of collaboration, free knowledge, and technology in service of communities.
about.knowledgeBaseTitle: Knowledge Base Used by the AI RAG
about.knowledgeBaseDescription: The documents page shows the knowledge base used by the Agroecology Map AI RAG system. These indexed sources are what the AI searches before writing an answer, so each response can stay connected to documents that people can inspect.
about.freeSoftwareDescription: Agroecology Map AI is released as Free Software under the GPLv3 license. This means the community can use, study, modify, and share the code, keeping the tool auditable and aligned with the public interest.
about.sourceKnowledgeDescription: Answers are built from indexed documents, such as scientific papers and technical texts. The AI should point to the sources it used so people can verify context and judge the quality of the answer.
about.communityDescription: The project grows out of the volunteer work that has sustained Agroecology Map for 8 years. It is built by people who believe in agroecology, social technologies, food sovereignty, and open collaboration.
about.creatorsDescription: The platform is created and maintained by volunteers connected to Agroecology Map. The maintainer list can grow as more people contribute code, documentation, data, and community review.
about.frontend: Frontend: React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS + Vite
about.backend: Backend: FastAPI + psycopg (async PostgreSQL) + LanceDB + Valkey/Redis
about.vectorStore: Vector Search: LanceDB (cosine) + BM25 keyword search + Reciprocal Rank Fusion
about.llm: LLM: DeepSeek v4 Flash (cloud) or Qwen3.5:4b (local) via Ollama / OpenAI-compatible API
about.suggestInviteDescription: Our Suggestions system lets anyone contribute: upload a PDF with a comment explaining why the material matters. Our team reviews every submission. Once approved - within 24 hours - the content is indexed and becomes available in the AI Chat. Every contribution makes the AI more informed about agroecological practices, scientific research, and local knowledge. Researchers, farmers, activists, students: your voice belongs in this dataset.
about.ctaDescription: Use the chat, check the cited sources, and help strengthen free software AI for agroecology.

donate.title: Support Agroecology Map AI
donate.metaDescription: Help maintain and expand Agroecology Map AI, a free software artificial intelligence platform for agroecology.
donate.whatIs: Agroecology Map AI is an artificial intelligence platform specialized in agroecology. It transforms scientific papers, field manuals, technical booklets, theses, and reports into a searchable knowledge base, allowing people to ask questions in natural language and receive answers with source citations. Unlike generic chatbots, the platform answers based on the provided documents - without inventing facts or hiding where information came from. Our goal is to democratize access to agroecological knowledge for farmers, researchers, extension workers, educators, and communities through a reliable, free software tool designed to run on local infrastructure.
donate.intro: Agroecology Map AI is the next step in 8 years of volunteer work on Agroecology Map: a free software AI that makes agroecological knowledge more accessible, traceable, and useful for communities, researchers, and farmers.

history.title: 8 Years of History
history.content: Since 2016, Agroecology Map has been a free and open citizen science and open data platform that enables people worldwide to map, connect, and share agroecological practices. Born in Brasília, Brazil, the project grew organically: from a local initiative into a global network, with thousands of mapped experiences and a community of farmers, researchers, extension workers, educators, and activists.
history.body: This history was built without investors or corporate control. The work happened during nights, weekends, and holidays because we believe that every mapped agroecological experience is a seed of knowledge that can inspire others, strengthen networks, and accelerate fairer and more sustainable farming practices.

importance.title: Why This Project Matters
importance.content: The climate crisis, biodiversity loss, and food insecurity demand concrete responses. Agroecology shows that it is possible to produce food while regenerating ecosystems, strengthening communities, and preserving traditional knowledge. But this knowledge is still scattered across papers, booklets, reports, and local experiences, often difficult to find, translate, and apply.
importance.body: Agroecology Map AI helps make this knowledge more accessible. It connects trustworthy documents to real questions, always keeping sources traceable. Unlike commercial platforms, we do not sell data, charge subscriptions, or put knowledge behind paywalls. All software is free under the GPLv3 license, so the community can use, study, modify, and share it.

voluntary.title: 100% Volunteer Effort
voluntary.content: Agroecology Map is maintained by a small team of volunteers - developers, researchers, and activists - who dedicate their free time to building and improving the platform. We have no investors, corporate sponsors, or significant external funding. We do this because we deeply believe in agroecology, free software, and the transformative power of shared knowledge.
voluntary.body: But there are limits to what volunteer work can sustain on its own. As Agroecology Map AI grows, processing, storage, and development costs increase. The donation we are asking for is specific: acquiring dedicated local equipment to accelerate development and reduce dependence on cloud services.

aiNeeds.title: The Need for AI Processing Power
aiNeeds.content: To turn documents into a searchable knowledge base, Agroecology Map AI needs to process large volumes of text, generate embeddings, index files, and query language models. This requires much more processing power than a regular web server.
aiNeeds.body: Today this work runs on limited personal hardware, which slows down indexing, restricts experiments with open models, and makes it harder to serve more people. A workstation with a dedicated GPU will allow us to process documents faster, test local models through Ollama, advance fine-tuning work, and keep the project more independent from major cloud providers.

equipment.title: Goal: USD 3,000
equipment.description: This equipment will be dedicated to Agroecology Map AI for data processing, document indexing, tests with local models, fine-tuning open models, and ongoing platform improvements. It also brings us closer to a self-hostable infrastructure, with less cloud dependency and more technological sovereignty for the community.

howToHelp.title: How You Can Help
howToHelp.description: Your contribution, of any amount, brings us closer to the USD 3,000 goal to acquire local development equipment. With your help, we will be able to accelerate AI processing, test open models, reduce external dependencies, and keep the platform free and open. Every contribution turns into more reliable agroecological knowledge available to the people who need it.
howToHelp.qrAlt: QR code to support Agroecology Map AI on Ko-fi
howToHelp.other: Other ways to contribute: share the platform with your community, contribute documents to the knowledge base, or join us as a development volunteer. Every form of support strengthens our mission.

supporters.title: Supporters and Donors
supporters.description: We will also be happy to publicly recognize people who support Agroecology Map AI. If you want, we can include your name and link in this list of supporters and donors.

gratitude.title: Our Gratitude
gratitude.content: With every person who uses, shares, or contributes to Agroecology Map, our community grows stronger. We believe that agroecology is the way forward, and that together we can build the tools our communities need to flourish. Thank you so much for being part of this story.
gratitude.closing: With love, the Agroecology Map volunteer team.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.metaDescription: Agroecology Map AI Privacy Policy - how we collect, use, and protect your data.

intro.title: Introduction
intro.content: Agroecology Map AI ("we", "our", or "the platform") is committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring transparency about how your personal data is handled. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, why we collect it, how it is used, stored, shared, and how you can exercise your rights.

dataController.title: Data Controller
dataController.content: The data controller for Agroecology Map AI is the Agroecology Map project, a free software, open data, and citizen science initiative. For questions, contact: contact@agroecologymap.org.

whatWeCollect.title: What We Collect
whatWeCollect.content:
When you register an account, we collect:

- Full name (required for display and community interaction)
- Email address (required for account verification, recovery, and notifications)
- Password (stored only as a bcrypt hash with a secret pepper - never stored in plain text)
- Preferred locale/language (to present the interface in your language)

Optional profile data you may provide after registration:

- Bio/About text (up to 4096 characters)
- External link (URL to your website or profile)
- Profile avatar image (processed to 256x256 WebP)

When you submit document suggestions:

- Your user comment about the suggested document
- The PDF file you upload (if applicable)

Chat history may be stored locally in your browser or mobile app storage so you can continue recent conversations on the same device.

automaticallyCollected.title: Automatically Collected Data
automaticallyCollected.content:
When you use the platform, we automatically log:

- Your IP address (in request logs for security and debugging purposes, stored in stdout logs only - not in the database)
- Timestamps of actions (account creation, login, profile updates)
- Question character counts and performance metrics when using the Chat feature (the full text of your questions is NOT stored in server logs)

We DO NOT use advertising cookies, browser fingerprinting, tracking pixels, or third-party analytics services. The web and mobile apps use local storage only for session data, language preference, consent choice, and local chat history.

whatWeDontCollect.title: What We DON'T Collect
whatWeDontCollect.content:
We do not collect:

- Location data (beyond IP address, which is logged transiently)
- Browsing history or behavior tracking
- Device or hardware identifiers
- Advertising identifiers
- Sensitive personal data (race, ethnicity, political opinions, health data, etc.)
- Payment information (donations are handled by Ko-fi and Patreon on their own platforms)

purpose.title: Purpose and Legal Basis
purpose.content:
We process your personal data for the following purposes, based on the legal grounds under the Brazilian General Data Protection Law (LGPD, Law 13.709/2018) and the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR):

- Account creation and authentication (legal basis: performance of a contract - LGPD Art. 7, V / GDPR Art. 6(1)(b))
- Email communication (account verification, password reset, notifications about your suggestions) (legal basis: legitimate interest - LGPD Art. 7, IX / GDPR Art. 6(1)(f))
- Community profile display (name, about, link, avatar) (legal basis: consent and legitimate interest - LGPD Art. 7, I / GDPR Art. 6(1)(a))
- Platform operation and improvement (legal basis: legitimate interest - LGPD Art. 7, IX / GDPR Art. 6(1)(f))
- Compliance with legal obligations (legal basis: legal obligation - LGPD Art. 7, II / GDPR Art. 6(1)(c))

dataStorage.title: Data Storage and Security
dataStorage.content:
Your personal data is stored in:

- PostgreSQL database (users table) - email, name, hashed password, profile fields, timestamps
- Local server filesystem - uploaded avatars (as WebP images), document PDFs
- LanceDB vector store - text chunks from ingested documents (no personal data, only knowledge base content)
- Local browser or mobile app storage - session state, language preference, consent choice, and recent chat history on your own device
- Email confirmations, password reset tokens, and refresh tokens are stored with SHA-256 hashing and automatic expiration

AI processing runs on models hosted locally or on infrastructure controlled by the project. Questions, chat history, embeddings, and documents are not sent to external AI APIs.

We implement the following security measures:

- Passwords are hashed with bcrypt (12 rounds) plus a configurable secret pepper
- Authentication uses JWT access tokens (15-minute TTL) with refresh token rotation
- Email addresses in logs are masked (e.g., j***e@example.com)
- All APIs use HTTPS in production

dataSharing.title: Data Sharing
dataSharing.content:
We do NOT share, sell, rent, or trade your personal data with third parties. Specifically:

- No data is shared with advertisers or marketing companies
- No data is sold to data brokers
- No data is transferred to external analytics services
- Questions, chat history, embeddings, and documents are not sent to external AI providers
- No data is shared with government entities without a valid legal order

Donation links open external platforms such as Ko-fi or Patreon, which process donations under their own policies. The source code of the platform is publicly available under the GPLv3 license, allowing independent verification of our data practices.

dataRetention.title: Data Retention
dataRetention.content:
We retain your personal data for as long as your account remains active. When you delete your account:

- Your name, email, about text, external link, and avatar are permanently anonymized or deleted
- Your account status changes to "deleted"
- All active sessions and refresh tokens are revoked
- Contributions you made to the knowledge base (document suggestions, approved documents) are retained in anonymized form to preserve the integrity of the platform
- Temporary logs containing IP addresses rotate out within system log retention cycles (typically days to weeks)

userRights.title: Your Rights
userRights.content:
Under LGPD and GDPR, you have the following rights regarding your personal data:

1. Right to Access - request a copy of all data we hold about you (use the "Export My Data" button on your profile)
2. Right to Rectification - correct inaccurate or incomplete data (edit your profile at any time)
3. Right to Erasure ("Right to be Forgotten") - request deletion of your personal data (use the "Delete My Account" button on your profile)
4. Right to Data Portability - receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format (use the "Export My Data" button)
5. Right to Withdraw Consent - you may stop using the platform and delete your account at any time
6. Right to Information - request clarification about how your data is processed

To exercise any of these rights, contact: contact@agroecologymap.org

rightToBeForgotten.title: Right to be Forgotten (Account Deletion)
rightToBeForgotten.content:
You can request account deletion directly from your profile page by clicking "Delete My Account". The deletion process works as follows:

1. Click "Delete My Account" on your profile page and confirm the action
2. You will receive a confirmation email with a unique link
3. Click the link within 1 hour to confirm the deletion
4. Once confirmed, your personal data is permanently anonymized:
   - Full name becomes "Deleted User"
   - Email is replaced with a non-identifiable placeholder
   - Bio, link, and avatar are deleted
   - Account status is set to "deleted"
   - All active sessions are terminated

Your contributions (document suggestions, approved documents) remain in the knowledge base in anonymized form to preserve platform integrity.

If you cannot access your account, you may also request deletion by sending an email to contact@agroecologymap.org from the email address associated with your account.

appStoreCompliance.title: App Store Compliance
appStoreCompliance.content:
The Agroecology Map AI mobile application follows app store privacy requirements:

- No camera, microphone, contacts, or location access is requested
- Photo library access may be requested only when you choose a profile avatar; only the selected image is uploaded
- Network access is used exclusively for API communication with our servers
- No background data collection or processing occurs
- No third-party SDKs or analytics frameworks are embedded
- All data transmission uses HTTPS encryption
- The app does not access, collect, or transmit data from other apps on your device
- No advertising or tracking identifiers are used

contact.title: Contact and DPO
contact.content:
For any questions, concerns, or requests related to your privacy and personal data, contact our Data Protection Officer:

Email: contact@agroecologymap.org
Project: Agroecology Map AI
License: GPLv3 (Free Software)
Repository: https://codeberg.org/agroecologymap

We will respond to all privacy-related inquiries within 15 business days.

updates.title: Changes to This Policy
updates.content:
This Privacy Policy may be updated from time to time to reflect changes in our data practices or legal requirements. When material changes are made, we will:

- Notify all registered users via email
- Update the "Last updated" date at the top of this page
- For significant changes that affect your rights, we may require you to re-accept the updated policy

We encourage you to review this policy periodically. Continued use of the platform after changes take effect constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

termsOfService.metaDescription: Agroecology Map AI Terms of Service - rules and conditions for using the platform.
termsOfService.content:

Agroecology Map AI is a free software platform that provides an AI-powered chat interface for querying a curated knowledge base of agroecological documents. The Platform also allows users to suggest new documents for inclusion and participate in a community of practice.

The Agroecology Map AI software is licensed under the GNU General Public License v3 (GPLv3). The knowledge base content (documents) retains its original licenses and attributions. The Platform is provided "AS IS" without warranty of any kind, express or implied. We do not guarantee that the AI-generated answers are accurate, complete, or suitable for any particular purpose. Always verify information with primary sources.

8. Limitation of Liability

9. Account Termination

We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these Terms. Users may delete their accounts at any time through the profile page. Upon deletion, personal data is anonymized per our Privacy Policy.

10. Modifications to Terms

We may update these Terms from time to time. Material changes will be communicated via email. Continued use after changes take effect constitutes acceptance of the updated Terms.

11. Governing Law

These Terms are governed by the laws of Brazil. Any disputes shall be resolved in the courts of Brasília, Distrito Federal, Brazil.

For questions about these Terms, contact: contact@agroecologymap.org
